'''''Moth''''' was a [[Container transport]] belonging to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. It was present at a Rebel supply depot that was attacked and destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces from the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] [[Lightning (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Lightning'']]. The transport attempted to flee the battle but was destroyed instead. The attack on the Rebel depot was then recorded and recreated to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]] in the [[Combat chamber]]. One of those pilots was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
